reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 9 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Rockets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Rockets win 79 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.

analyst.text: Philadelphia play the second night of a road back-to-back after Indiana, without Jaylen Brown (hamstring), and with Joel Embiid (illness) uncertain. Ime Udoka called his Rockets 'mentally fragile' after a Cup loss in Denver last week, but they have since steadied, and Alperen Sengun is playing through an eye injury. The spot leans Houston.
